code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx:313 (empty COURT route comment), pages/Notice/form/History.tsx (Court Application History grid commented out), pages/Report/index.tsx. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui: no court application submit code.
note: 1-point story (status_with_ura: Fully paid): a back action from the 'list of reviewed notices + summary' screen to the previous screen. That screen itself (OCMS22.20) is not in code, so there is nothing to go back from. The Court Application feature is not built in the six repos; only small leftovers exist (empty route comment, Report menu items without a path, TypeScript types). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The Court Application feature (submission to State Courts) is not in the six repos; only comments, TypeScript types and menu placeholders remain. Ask URA/the team in which repo it was built, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The 'list of reviewed notices and summary count' screen for submission to State Courts is displayed
steps.detail: There is no Court Application page or route in ocmsadminui: App.tsx only has an empty comment {/* COURT */} (App.tsx:313) and no batch review/submit route. Searching 3+ synonyms (court application, court batch, csd batch, charge sheet, case registration) across ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi and thirdpartyapi found no controller, service or page that submits to State Courts. This screen is the output of OCMS22.20 and does not exist.

steps.step: A control (Back button) on the review screen returns to the previous screen
steps.detail: There is no Back/Cancel component for the court application flow because the review screen does not exist. Generic browser or other-page navigation is not counted as code for this story.

steps.step: After Back, the OIC returns to the previous notice list and can continue reviewing
steps.detail: The notice list screen for court application review (OCMS22.3/22.19) does not exist. The only trace is the 'Court Application History' tab in History.tsx, which is commented out (History.tsx:170-172), and its grid (History.tsx:71) uses a courtcase resource that has no backend endpoint.
